## What this region is

The routing planner: a Sonnet run on the host that cuts each session into parts and names the organizations whose work each part is, the code that validates every plan (it can only narrow), scheduling, re-planning and backfill, the review queue, and the part rows with their redactions.

## What it exists for

- Get sessions planned
- Feed, record and review plans
- Update a plan when a session or charter changes
- Turn a plan into part rows with redactions

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- declare which projects an organization owns → routing-organizations
- choose whether career talk holds a part or is redacted → routing-organizations
- send the parts to the company's hosted archive → destinations-and-sync
- run a model pass in an isolated, uncaptured Claude session → tags-and-tagger
- add a column to the routing plans table → session-store
